race.comment: Tricky with quite a few of these dual-accepted. KATOTO (6) should be running and looks a nice bet. She ran on quite well late in the Listed Jim Moloney behind Regal Ambition second up and the rise in trip should suit. Off a freshen to 1800m is a slight niggle but we'll back the Waller/J-Mac combination. WAIHEKE ROSE (7) comes down from NSW off a dominant maiden win at Kembla Grange, scoring by three lengths in fast time over a handy reference. Should relish 1800m and hits this on the up. FRINGILLA (8) skipped the Wakeful to come here. The maiden win at Geelong was strong before starting favourite in the G3 Ethereal last time. Back slightly in trip suits. STAR OF MACEDON (2) opts here instead of the Carbine Club on Saturday and should improve rising in trip third up.
